\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{tikz}
\newsavebox{\probe}
\newcommand{\report}[2]{%
  \sbox{\probe}{\begin{tikzpicture}#2\end{tikzpicture}}%
  \typeout{BOUNDS #1: width=\the\wd\probe; height=\the\ht\probe; depth=\the\dp\probe}%
}
\begin{document}
\report{plain}{\draw[line width=4pt] (0,0) -- (2,0);}
\report{labelled}{\draw[line width=4pt] (0,0) -- node[above] {$x$} (2,0);}
\report{empty-node}{\draw[line width=4pt] (0,0) -- node[inner sep=0pt] {} (2,0);}
\report{arrow-labelled}{\draw[thick,-stealth] (0,0) -- node[above] {$x$} (2,0);}
\report{arrow-plain}{\draw[thick,-stealth] (0,0) -- (2,0);}
\report{fill-labelled}{\fill (0,0) rectangle (2,1) node[midway] {$x$};}
\end{document}
